description: Update recipe metadata and content. Only provide fields you want to update. Steps can't be matched by id, so sending steps recreates them all and loses step names, headers, files and sub-recipes. keywords and properties replace the list (properties accept id).

internal.description: Native Tandoor recipe, not an external file.

keywords.description: Keyword names; replaces the list. Missing names are created.

source.description: Where the nutrition values came from.

private.description: Hide from other space members unless shared.

properties.description: Replaces the property list; id updates an existing entry.

id.description: Existing recipe property ID to update in place.

property_amount.description: Value in the property type unit.

show_ingredient_overview.description: Show all ingredients above the steps.

source_url.description: Web address the recipe came from.

steps.description: Replaces all steps; step names and sub-recipes are lost.

ingredients.description: Ingredients used in this step; may be empty.

food.description: Food name; matched case-insensitively or created.

unit.description: Unit name; matched case-insensitively or created.

waiting_time.description: Passive time, e.g. baking, in minutes.

name: update_recipe
title: Update recipe
